Jaguar Land Rover Seeks £1 Billion Loan Amid Tata Leadership Questions

Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) is in discussions with eight to nine banks to secure a £1 billion loan. This move comes amid uncertainty surrounding leadership at its parent company, Tata. Separately, Legora is reportedly in talks to raise funds at an approximate valuation of $8.5 billion.
